methods.name: find
methods.signature: (options: ContactFindOptions, success: (result: ContactFindResult) => void, error: (error: PluginError) => void) => void
methods.docs:
Queries the device contacts database and calls `success` with the
matching contacts.

Requests the READ_CONTACTS (Android) / Contacts (iOS) permission
internally the first time it runs; there is no separate permission method.

**iOS 18+:** under Limited Access the search runs against (and returns
only) the subset of contacts the user shared with the app.

methods.name: save
methods.signature: (options: ContactSaveOptions, success: (contact: Contact) => void, error: (error: PluginError) => void) => void
methods.docs:
Persists a new contact or updates an existing one (matched by
`contact.id`). Calls `success` with the full saved contact.

Requests the READ/WRITE_CONTACTS (Android) / Contacts (iOS) permission
internally.

**iOS 18+:** works under Limited Access — new contacts are added to the
app's accessible set; updating requires the target contact to be in that
set (otherwise the call fails with `OS-PLUG-CONT-0001`).

methods.name: remove
methods.signature: (options: ContactRemoveOptions, success: () => void, error: (error: PluginError) => void) => void
methods.docs:
Removes the contact with the given `id` from the device contacts
database. Fails with `OS-PLUG-CONT-0001` when no contact has that id (on
iOS 18+ Limited Access, also when the contact is outside the accessible
set).

Requests the READ/WRITE_CONTACTS (Android) / Contacts (iOS) permission
internally.

methods.name: pickContact
methods.signature: (success: (contact: Contact) => void, error: (error: PluginError) => void) => void
methods.docs:
Launches the native contact picker UI and calls `success` with the
contact the user selects. Fails with `OS-PLUG-CONT-0006` if the user
cancels.

On iOS the system picker requires no permission and always shows the full
contact list — even under iOS 18+ Limited Access (the picked contact is
returned without joining the app's accessible set). On Android the
READ_CONTACTS permission is requested internally to read the picked
contact's details.

properties.name: fields
properties.docs:
Fields to search against. Pass `['*']` to match every field. An empty
array is invalid and fails with `OS-PLUG-CONT-0001`. The `id` field
matches by exact identifier; all other fields match case-insensitive
substrings. `photos` and `categories` are not searchable.

properties.name: filter
properties.docs:
Search string matched (case-insensitively) against the selected `fields`.
An empty/omitted filter returns every contact.

properties.name: multiple
properties.docs:
When `true`, returns every match; when `false` (default), returns at most
one contact.

properties.name: desiredFields
properties.docs:
If set, each returned {@link Contact} only includes these fields (plus the
always-present `id`).

properties.name: hasPhoneNumber
properties.docs:
OutSystems extension: when `true`, only contacts that have at least one
phone number are returned. Defaults to `false`.

properties.name: contacts
properties.docs: The contacts matching the search criteria.

properties.name: id
properties.docs:
Globally unique, platform-assigned identifier. Absent for contacts not yet
saved to the device.

properties.name: rawId
properties.docs:
Android raw-contact id backing this aggregated contact. iOS leaves this
unset.

properties.name: displayName
properties.docs: Name suitable for display to end users.

properties.name: name
properties.docs: The structured name components.

properties.name: nickname
properties.docs: A casual name by which to address the contact.

properties.name: phoneNumbers
properties.docs: The contact's phone numbers.

properties.name: emails
properties.docs: The contact's email addresses.

properties.name: addresses
properties.docs: The contact's postal addresses.

properties.name: ims
properties.docs: The contact's instant-messaging handles.

properties.name: organizations
properties.docs: The contact's organizations.

properties.name: birthday
properties.docs: The contact's birthday as epoch milliseconds.

properties.name: note
properties.docs:
A free-form note about the contact.

**iOS:** not supported by default — reading/writing a contact's note
requires Apple's restricted `com.apple.developer.contacts.notes`
entitlement. Without it the field is omitted on read and ignored on save.
Android has no such restriction.

properties.name: photos
properties.docs:
The contact's photos. Reads always return `type: 'base64'` with the
`value` holding the base64-encoded image on both platforms. On save, the
first entry is applied: pass `type: 'base64'` with base64 data, or
`type: 'url'` with a local `file://`/`content://` URI to import.

properties.name: categories
properties.docs:
User-defined categories associated with the contact. Read-only: populated
from the contact's group memberships on Android, never returned on iOS
(the Contacts framework has no equivalent), and ignored on save.

properties.name: urls
properties.docs: Web pages associated with the contact.

properties.name: formatted
properties.docs: The complete formatted name.

properties.name: familyName
properties.docs: Family (last) name.

properties.name: givenName
properties.docs: Given (first) name.

properties.name: middleName
properties.docs: Middle name.

properties.name: honorificPrefix
properties.docs: Honorific prefix (e.g. `Mr.`, `Dr.`).

properties.name: honorificSuffix
properties.docs: Honorific suffix (e.g. `Esq.`).

interfaces.name: ContactField
interfaces.docs:
A generic, repeatable contact field (phone number, email, IM, photo, URL,
category).

properties.name: type
properties.docs:
The kind of field, e.g. `home`, `work`, `mobile`. For photos, `url` or
`base64`.

properties.name: value
properties.docs: The field value (phone number, email address, URI, etc.).

properties.name: pref
properties.docs: `true` if this is the contact's preferred value for the field.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Platform-assigned id of this individual field entry.

interfaces.name: ContactAddress
interfaces.docs: A postal address of a {@link Contact}.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: Platform-assigned id of this address entry.

properties.name: pref
properties.docs: `true` if this is the contact's preferred address.

properties.name: type
properties.docs: The kind of address, e.g. `home`, `work`.

properties.name: formatted
properties.docs: The full address formatted for display.

properties.name: streetAddress
properties.docs: The street address.

properties.name: locality
properties.docs: The city or locality.

properties.name: region
properties.docs: The state or region.

properties.name: postalCode
properties.docs: The ZIP or postal code.

properties.name: country
properties.docs: The country name.

interfaces.name: ContactOrganization
interfaces.docs: An organization a {@link Contact} belongs to.

properties.name: id
properties.docs:
Platform-assigned id of this organization entry. Android only — iOS
models the organization as flat contact properties without an id.

properties.name: pref
properties.docs: `true` if this is the contact's preferred organization.

properties.name: type
properties.docs: The kind of organization, e.g. `work`.

properties.name: name
properties.docs: The organization name.

properties.name: department
properties.docs: The department within the organization.

properties.name: title
properties.docs: The contact's title at the organization.

interfaces.name: PluginError
interfaces.docs: Error delivered to every failure callback.

properties.name: code
properties.docs:
Unified error code in the `OS-PLUG-CONT-NNNN` format, identical across
this plugin and `@capacitor/contacts`.

properties.name: message
properties.docs: Human-readable description of the failure.

properties.name: contact
properties.docs:
The contact to create (no `id`) or update (existing `id`).

Update semantics: every field present on the contact replaces the stored
value entirely (e.g. `name` replaces the whole structured name,
`phoneNumbers` replaces all phone numbers); omitted fields are left
unchanged.

properties.name: id
properties.docs: The native id of the contact to remove.

typeAliases.name: ContactFieldType
typeAliases.docs:
The set of contact fields a {@link IContacts.find} call can search
against or request back. Mirrors the legacy Cordova `ContactFieldType`
string values exactly.
